title: Chinese President Xi Jinping says Taiwan 'reunification' must happen as history cannot be stopped
paragraphs: Chinese President Xi Jinping says Taiwan 'reunification' must happen as history cannot be stopped
Resolving the Taiwan question is an "unwavering historical mission" of China's Communist Party, said Chinese President Xi Jinping.

BEIJING: The tide of history cannot be stopped, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Thursday (Nov 12), as he urged complete "reunification" of Taiwan with the motherland and pledged to do so peacefully, making no mention of the use of force.
